<parameter name="content">const express = require('express');
const crypto = require('crypto');
const { promisify } = require('util');

const scrypt = promisify(crypto.scrypt);

db.exec(`
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, pw TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions(
  token_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, expires INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS attempts(
  key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, fails INTEGER NOT NULL, first_at INTEGER NOT NULL, locked_until INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);
`);

const SESSION_MS = 7 * 24 * 3600e3;
const WINDOW_MS = 15 * 60e3;
const LIMITS = { acct: 5, ip: 20 }; // failures per window before lock

// --- password hashing: scrypt, per-user salt, constant-time compare ---
async function hashPw(pw) {
  const salt = crypto.randomBytes(16);
  const h = await scrypt(pw, salt, 64);
  return `${salt.toString('hex')}:${h.toString('hex')}`;
}
async function checkPw(pw, stored) {
  const [s, h] = stored.split(':');
  const calc = await scrypt(pw, Buffer.from(s, 'hex'), 64);
  return crypto.timingSafeEqual(calc, Buffer.from(h, 'hex'));
}
let DUMMY; // verify against this when user missing → no timing oracle for enumeration
hashPw('dummy').then((h) => (DUMMY = h));

// --- rate limiting (persisted, fixed window → lockout) ---
const sha = (s) => crypto.createHash('sha256').update(s).digest('hex');
function lockedFor(key) {
  const r = db.prepare('SELECT locked_until FROM attempts WHERE key=?').get(key);
  return r && r.locked_until > Date.now() ? Math.ceil((r.locked_until - Date.now()) / 1000) : 0;
}
function recordFail(key, max) {
  const now = Date.now();
  const r = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM attempts WHERE key=?').get(key);
  const fails = !r || now - r.first_at > WINDOW_MS ? 1 : r.fails + 1;
  const first = !r || now - r.first_at > WINDOW_MS ? now : r.first_at;
  const lock = fails >= max ? now + WINDOW_MS : 0;
  db.prepare(
    `INSERT INTO attempts(key,fails,first_at,locked_until) VALUES(?,?,?,?)
     ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET fails=?, first_at=?, locked_until=?`
  ).run(key, fails, first, lock, fails, first, lock);
}
const clear = (key) => db.prepare('DELETE FROM attempts WHERE key=?').run(key);

// --- sessions: random token to client, only its hash stored ---
function issueSession(res, userId) {
  const token = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('base64url');
  db.prepare('INSERT INTO sessions VALUES(?,?,?)').run(sha(token), userId, Date.now() + SESSION_MS);
  res.cookie('sid', token, {
    httpOnly: true, sameSite: 'lax', secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production',
    maxAge: SESSION_MS, path: '/',
  });
}
function readCookie(req, name) {
  const m = (req.headers.cookie || '').split(/;\s*/).find((c) => c.startsWith(name + '='));
  return m && decodeURIComponent(m.slice(name.length + 1));

}

const app = express();

const EMAIL_RE = /^[^\s@]{1,64}@[^\s@]{1,255}$/;
function parse(body) {
  const email = typeof body?.email === 'string' ? body.email.trim().toLowerCase() : '';
  const password = typeof body?.password === 'string' ? body.password : '';
  return { email, password };
}

app.post('/signup', async (req, res) => {
  const { email, password } = parse(req.body);
  if (!EMAIL_RE.test(email)) return res.status(400).json({ error: 'invalid email' });
  if (password.length < 8 || password.length > 128)

    issueSession(res, lastInsertRowid);
    res.status(201).json({ ok: true });
